info.name: ConnectaOficios - API Testing
info.description: Local API testing. Angel Mate: CON-271, CON-485..491, CON-566..569. Original general requests retain their scripts and are not reassigned. CON-271 reuses Login Cliente; CON-568 reuses the existing filtered pagination request. Run the complete collection in order. npm run api provisions the original local fixtures through official APIs; npm run api:local starts isolated SQL Express and Java using its existing H2 test datasource (MySQL mode), real JWT security and local image provider. This validates HTTP integration, not MySQL/production parity. No real users, external email, payments, or destructive cleanup. Import local.environment.json and supply password locally; never export runtime tokens.

exec: pm.test('CON-487 JWT .NET aceptado por Java - HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: CON-488 Rol trabajador del JWT reconocido

exec: pm.test('CON-488 Rol trabajador del JWT reconocido - HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('CON-488 - rol .NET trabajador y recurso esperado',()=>{const token=pm.collectionVariables.get('javaTrabajadorToken');const claims=JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1].replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/')));pm.expect(claims['http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/role']).eq('Trabajador');const j=pm.response.json();pm.expect(j).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty;pm.expect(j.some(p=>p.id===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('promocionId')))).eq(true);j.forEach(p=>pm.expect(p.trabajadorId).eq(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('javaTrabajadorId'))));});
